'''Binders''', also called '''cuffs''', were common [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] restraints made of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] placed around a person's limbs.

==Description==
Binders were common and basic [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] restraint cuffs made of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]].<ref name="EGWT" /> Binders were designed with the intent of keeping a conscious [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] controlled and subdued.<ref name="EotE-Core">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> They were strong enough to keep a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee's]] arms restrained,<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> and could be locked and secured by mechanical [[Lock/Legends|locks]], [[key-code chip reader]]s, [[identity scanner]]s,<ref name="EGWT" /> or code inputs.<ref name="NEGWT" />

Many different companies manufactured binders, including [[Locris Syndicated Securities/Legends|Locris Syndicated Securities]]. While the products differed from each other, they shared the same basic design.<ref name="EotE-Core" />

==History==
Binders were an essential piece of equipment for [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].<ref name="EotE-Core" />

[[File:PrisonerStunCuffs-WalkingThePathThatsGiven.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Imperial prisoners in binders]]
The [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] used binders on their prisoners in their gladiatorial arenas on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. These binders had pulse lock points that welded the clasps tight. They also featured an electronic release mechanism. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] were fitted with such binders for their scheduled execution in the [[Petranaki arena]], but were able to defeat their captors and executioners.<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

Binders were used aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] to restrain dangerous prisoners. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] fitted [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] with a pair of binders when he and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] posed as [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in their attempt to [[Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends|rescue]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].<ref name="EGWT" /> Skywalker was originally going to outfit Chewbacca with the binders, but he had Solo do it instead after the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] snarled at him.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> They left the binders unlocked as they entered the [[Detention Block AA-23/Legends|detention block]], allowing the Wookiee to "break free" and aid his companions in the firefight that followed.<ref name="EGWT" />
